children: Campbell's reported fiscal 2026 net sales of $9.7 billion, a 5% decline year-over-year (2% organic decline), and GAAP diluted EPS of $1.31 ($1.31 reported full-year). Adjusted diluted EPS was $2.17 for the full year, down 27% from prior year, while adjusted EBIT was $1.18 billion. The company announced a new enterprise-wide cost savings program targeting $500 million by fiscal 2030 and reset its quarterly dividend to $0.25 to accelerate debt reduction.
Net sales (FY26): $9,744 million, down 5% versus FY25; organic net sales down 2%.
Fourth-quarter net sales: $2,137 million, down 8% year-over-year; organic decline of 1% (prior year included an extra week).
Gross profit (Q4): $583 million; gross profit margin 27.3% (Q4 adjusted gross profit $611 million; adjusted margin 28.6%).
Earnings before interest and taxes (EBIT) (FY26): $852 million; adjusted EBIT: $1,181 million (down 21% year-over-year).
Adjusted diluted EPS (FY26): $2.17 (down 27%); Q4 adjusted diluted EPS: $0.39 (down 37%).
La Regina acquisition completed May 4, 2026; its results are fully consolidated and expected to modestly benefit net sales and be neutral to adjusted EPS for FY27.
Launched a new enterprise-wide cost savings and spend optimization program targeting $500 million in savings by fiscal 2030; prior program achieved ~$225 million to date.
Operational actions already underway include plant closures and workforce reductions as part of overhead and productivity initiatives.

Segment performance in Q4: Meals & Beverages organic net sales up 3% (volume/mix driven); Snacks organic net sales down 6%, with weakness in salty portfolio and third‑party partner/contract manufacturing sales.

Cash flow from operations (FY26): $1.0 billion; capital expenditures reduced to $361 million for the year versus $426 million prior year, while the company returned $496 million to shareholders in the fiscal year.
This is an AI-powered summary. It may contain inaccuracies. Consider verifying important information with the source. Please note this summary is solely based on documents filed with the SEC.

title: Campbell's reports FY26 revenue $9.7B, adjusted EPS $2.17; launches $500M cost-savings plan
